evidence: Intermediate candidate Runtime 8d88bcd1d83c4e9b3070259060c6630b8e006e90f6f633459a3ebbe75b20b1c6 reached Build with the same Run and user edit. Subsequent source changes required a final-candidate rerun.

Final candidate Native Runtime SHA-256 d38cb3ab43beee75e1848ec8c9a2024b6db7c033d24ad4eac1bc7bdf74f30359. The controller changed true to !false; the real Codex model inspected the edit and resumed the original Run without a repeated user decision.

cases.reproduction: 实际A5 Classic GLM在只判断proposal后因遗漏Spec的checkpoint失败，错误执行Runtime建议的revise-design，从Archive回Design并清空当前验收和归档确认，虽然任务明确没有新增授权。模型最终承认该错误，原实验保留。
cases.expected: Runtime提供命令不构成新授权；多个正式来源可通过prepare-applied --file逐一补判断；缺授权时保持原Run、阶段、批准和检查，明确请求相关决定；已明确授权的修订仍可沿同Run继续。
cases.forbidden: 用需求修订代替补齐判断，未获决定就改变阶段、创建后继或重置既有结果；或对已有明确授权机械新增确认。
cases.rootCause: Skill要求缺授权时请求决定，但未明确修订提示不授予授权以及判断多份已应用材料的补充入口，模型把技术恢复路径当作可以立即执行的动作。

cases.behavior: 合法UTF-8 BOM源码在输入未变化且Node检查成功时可建立候选摘要并接受检查收据，读取不改写磁盘字节。
cases.reproduction: 非Git协调根下的独立子仓含已提交BOM模块，Node导入exit 0，但旧代码以OUTCOME_REJECTED拒绝null候选摘要；同内容无BOM对照可通过。
cases.expected: 有/无BOM均得到非空且匹配的候选摘要、完整稳定输入快照及通过的检查记录，源码字节保持原样，实际实现变更仍改变候选和检查摘要。
cases.forbidden: 把合法BOM误报为候选漂移、写回去除BOM、绕过原始字节校验或对真实实现变化复用旧候选。
cases.rootCause: UTF-8 TextDecoder在内存中消耗BOM，候选检查将解码文本重编码后与原始字节摘要比较，三字节差异导致返回null。

cases.behavior: Shape 确认前删除已声明的目标 Spec 并改为另一个目标 Spec 后，可以重新准备确认，声明的 spec_changes 换成新的目标能力；确认后已声明的目标 Spec 缺失仍被拒绝。
cases.reproduction: 在051源码的临时项目中，Native next 为 original-capability 准备 Shape 确认，然后删除 specs/original-capability 并新增 specs/replacement-capability；--confirmed 因文档变化回到 Shape，再次 next --summary 报 spec-document-missing: specs/original-capability/spec.md。SDK Run 下按 revise-requirements 修订同样报该错误并停在 prepare-shape-confirmation。
cases.expected: 重新准备确认成功，状态停在 await-user，spec_changes 只包含 replacement-capability 的 create；Build 等确认后阶段丢失已声明目标 Spec 仍报 spec-document-missing。
cases.forbidden: Shape 确认前要求恢复不再需要的目标 Spec 或改用正式删除声明；仅凭豁免理由或无关能力的正式删除隐藏缺失的已声明 Spec；确认后静默放过已声明 Spec 的缺失。
cases.rootCause: 文档检查把 Shape 中上一次准备时写入的 spec_changes 当作已确认的绑定集合，不区分确认前的提案与确认后的需求。

cases.behavior: When the coordinator fails during release, the process still removes the lock it holds instead of leaking it to its own later acquisitions.
cases.reproduction: On the base commit, make the coordinator directory unusable at release time. Release throws and the lock stays on disk owned by the current live pid; because a live pid is always reported as active, a later acquisition in the same process waits until its own deadline.
cases.expected: A failed coordinator release removes the lock that still belongs to this process and emits a warning, so the same process can acquire it again; a lock that is already gone is left unreported.
cases.forbidden: Leaving a lock held by this process in place so later acquisitions time out, or claiming a removal that did not happen.
cases.rootCause: The release path runs removeBound only inside withCoordinator and rethrows nothing; when the coordinator throws, the lock survives with the current live pid, and ownerStatus always reports that pid as active, so the leaked lock can never be judged stale.

cases.behavior: A lock that must not be removed is kept and reported with its outcome: metadata rewritten while held, an owner that republished the lock, or a release that could not run at all.
cases.reproduction: On the base commit, rewrite the lock content while it is held: release skips removeBound silently and the lock is kept with no warning. Republish the lock as another owner, or make the parent directory uninspectable: the only output is a generic release warning that does not name the state or the reason.
cases.expected: Each outcome is named in the output: a rewritten lock reports that it changed while held, a foreign lock reports that another holder owns it, and a release that cannot run reports its own failure reason. The lock is kept in every one of those cases, and a metadata change is never reported as a removal failure or the reverse.
cases.forbidden: Skipping release silently when the lock was rewritten, removing a lock this process does not own, or reporting a failed inspection or removal as a metadata change.
cases.rootCause: The release path skipped removeBound silently when the token did not match, and the catch block collapsed every failure into one generic warning, so a permission or ACL error was indistinguishable from a rewritten lock.

cases.behavior: When the archive moves a Git-tracked migration fence out of a transient directory (.comet-state.lock or .comet-state-transaction.json), delivery approves both the deletion of the active path and the write of the archived path; a commit that only deletes the active path without committing the archived copy must be rejected.
cases.reproduction: On the base commit, make the archive commit record both the deletion of the active path and the addition of the archived path. complete-delivery rejects the archive commit, reporting openspec/changes/<change>/.comet-state.lock/.comet-runtime-migration.json as an unapproved path; the .comet-state-transaction.json fence fails identically.
cases.expected: complete-delivery accepts the archive commit and the Run reaches done when the archived copy matches the recorded digest, and rejects the commit when the copy is missing or its content differs.
cases.forbidden: Judging a moved migration fence as an unapproved path, skipping approval for the deletion of the active path, approving the deletion without requiring the archived copy to land in the commit, or accepting an archived copy whose content differs from the recorded digest.
cases.rootCause: tree() excludes both transient directories, so the migration fence is captured only by migrationFiles() into optionalFiles and is remapped to the archive path; delivery approves the deletion side only for paths listed in sources, so the active path had no registration at all.

cases.behavior: Windows受管检查超时后保留原监管器供调用方确认整树终止；合法中断重试仍沿原候选回Build修复。
cases.reproduction: 在47d07e03的原Native CLI重试用例中，仅将第三次中断的真实终止调用延迟600ms，前两次正常；监管器250ms后抢先退出，第三次next返回65且停在Verify。独立真实进程复现也显示原监管器在调用方核对前退出。
cases.expected: Windows保持原监管器直到实际整树终止确认，POSIX继续快速自清理。原成功检查执行一次，中断检查执行三次，随后回Build/repair。
cases.forbidden: 把未确认终止当成功、按已退出进程的裸PID杀树、重放一次性成功检查、改变检查的10秒时限，或让POSIX等待Windows确认窗口。
cases.rootCause: f6776924将超时后的确认等待统一缩为250ms，Windows监管器可能在调用方实际taskkill确认前自行退出，丢失原ChildProcess身份并触发未确认终止。

cases.behavior: 插件SessionStart返回短入口与可读取的完整Rule路径，startup/resume/compact不自动重复完整规则。
cases.reproduction: 当前使用0.5.3插件的聊天，三次SessionStart真实日志逐字节相同，各10196B，源码无条件注入全Rule；生成Hook同输入回归在修改前失败。0.5.2 tag不含该插件，不能将其当作052用户反馈根因。
cases.expected: Codex/DSH生成Hook各事件返回短入口和绝对Rule路径；进入/恢复Comet前必须读完整Rule，已有效则复用、压缩丢失则重读；普通任务不初始化或启动Eval，PreToolUse仍拒绝跨change写入。
cases.forbidden: 持久去重导致新上下文缺规则、静默丢失规则、移除写入Guard、把普通项目初始化或声称模型压缩次数已验证改善。
cases.rootCause: SessionStart无条件展开完整Rule，平台重复触发时重复注入已有长指令。

cases.behavior: 旧业务事务继续读取原修复投影，拒绝未知字段、损坏字段和与阶段不符的 override，不恢复旧修复运行器。

cases.expected: 原 legacy 与扩展投影可读取；未知字段、错误 ID、无效预算和错误阶段 override 被拒绝。

cases.rootCause: 旧机制测试文件同时包含仍活跃的纯事务解析断言，需要拆分到保留的读取边界。
